excerpt: Together Compiler uses AI agents to rewrite and fuse the GPU kernels in a model’s forward pass. It beats hand-written megakernels by 28% on B200 (2,118 vs 1,649 tokens/s on Llama 3.2 1B). This is how we got from one to the other.

title: Last year we built megakernels. This year we deleted them: The road to Together Compiler
